risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, clearly explaining operating-income declines, same-store sales weakness, closures, weather, competition, and labor-cost pressures. Risk tone is mildly negative because several markets and properties experienced declining sales, while reported results benefited from acquisitions and nonrecurring liability reversals. Boilerplate accounting and forward-looking caveats introduce some uncertainty, but there is limited evidence of deliberate obfuscation.
